intent: A short divider between two controls inside a ButtonGroup.
typical_uses: The divider between the halves of a split button

dont_use_when.situation: A divider between sections or items outside any ButtonGroup

invariants.text: When `orientation` is omitted the divider is vertical, the opposite of Separator's own horizontal fallback; it does not read the enclosing group's orientation.
The rendered div carries `role="separator"` and `aria-orientation` matching the resolved orientation, from the primitive underneath.

a11y.by: the primitive's Separator (role="separator" and aria-orientation set from orientation), plus button-group.test.tsx asserting data-orientation="vertical" by default and "horizontal" when passed

render.states: render replaces the rendered element with one the caller supplies
render.because: Base UI's render prop takes an element or a function of the separator's own state, so its type is a union of a React element and a callback - the compiler emits one JSON type per property.

style.states: style accepts a function of the separator's state as well as a plain style object
style.because: Base UI widens React's `CSSProperties` to `CSSProperties | ((state) => CSSProperties)` so a caller can style off the primitive's own state (orientation). The compiler emits one JSON type per property, so nothing is asserted; the kit's own styling goes through button-group.module.css and separator.module.css, not through this.

good.title: Between the halves of a split button

bad.title: The default divider in a vertical group
bad.why: The divider stays vertical in a column of controls; pass `orientation="horizontal"` so it runs across the column.
